-- Snowy art skin. Visuals only; the existing scripts still own state and actions.
local ContentProvider = game:GetService("ContentProvider")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local M = {}
M.Assets = {
	panel = "rbxassetid://73131475669125", card = "rbxassetid://108488334852650", button = "rbxassetid://100281398843170", hex = "rbxassetid://92134257087385",
	damage = "rbxassetid://78096846367053", rewards = "rbxassetid://77298391197868", achievement = "rbxassetid://89448212190860", loading = "rbxassetid://114230466916343",
	snow = "rbxassetid://83244601927288", luck = "rbxassetid://74613534440214",
	quests = "rbxassetid://104333252369153", codes = "rbxassetid://116424506095790",
}
-- Roblox's uploaded texture is 1024px; source PNGs are preserved at 1254px.
M.Slice = Rect.new(237, 237, 787, 787)
local loaded, waiting = {}, {}
local bound = setmetatable({}, {__mode="k"})
local function whenReady(id, fn)
	if not RunService:IsRunning() or loaded[id] == true or ContentProvider:GetAssetFetchStatus(id)==Enum.AssetFetchStatus.Success then fn() return end
	if loaded[id] == false then return end
	waiting[id] = waiting[id] or {}
	table.insert(waiting[id], fn)
end
if RunService:IsClient() then
	for _, id in pairs(M.Assets) do
		if not waiting[id] then
			waiting[id] = {}
			task.spawn(function()
				local success = false
				local ok = pcall(function()
					ContentProvider:PreloadAsync({id}, function(_, status) success = status == Enum.AssetFetchStatus.Success end)
				end)
				loaded[id] = ok and success
				if loaded[id] then for _, fn in ipairs(waiting[id]) do fn() end end
				waiting[id] = nil
			end)
		end
	end
end

-- Art is below content. Layout containers are deliberately excluded.
function M.Skin(o, kind)
	if not o:IsA("GuiObject") or bound[o] then return end
	if o:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIListLayout") or o:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIGridLayout") then return end
	bound[o] = true
	local art = o:FindFirstChild("SnowArt") or Instance.new("ImageLabel")
	art.Name = "SnowArt"
	art:SetAttribute("SnowUIDecor", true)
	art.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	art.Active, art.Selectable = false, false
	art.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	art.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
	art.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	art.ZIndex = math.max(0, o.ZIndex - 1)
	art.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Slice
	art.SliceCenter = M.Slice
	art.SliceScale = kind == "panel" and 0.2 or 0.055
	art.Visible = true -- transparent unloaded art leaves the native card readable
	local function selectImage()
		local id = kind == "panel" and M.Assets.panel or M.Assets.card
		if kind == "button" then
			local c = o.BackgroundColor3
			local semantic = o.Text~="" or c.R > c.B * 1.2 or c.G > c.B * 1.15 or o:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIGradient")
			id = semantic and M.Assets.card or M.Assets.button
		end
		art.Image, art.Visible = id, true
		art.ImageRectOffset, art.ImageRectSize = Vector2.zero, Vector2.zero
		art.SliceCenter = M.Slice
		if id == M.Assets.button then
			-- Keep native alpha; sample the tight button rectangle without resampling the PNG.
			art.ImageRectOffset, art.ImageRectSize = Vector2.new(0, 343), Vector2.new(1024, 343)
			art.SliceCenter, art.SliceScale = Rect.new(204, 102, 820, 241), 0.07
		end
		whenReady(id, function() if art.Parent and art.Image == id then art.Visible = true end end)
	end
	art.Parent = o
	selectImage()
	if kind == "button" then o:GetPropertyChangedSignal("BackgroundColor3"):Connect(selectImage) end
	return art
end

function M.Icon(parent, id, pos, size, name)
	local img = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
	img.Name = name or "SnowSymbol"
	img:SetAttribute("SnowUIDecor", true)
	img.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	img.Active, img.Selectable = false, false
	img.Image, img.ScaleType = id, Enum.ScaleType.Fit
	img.Position, img.Size = pos, size
	img.ZIndex = parent:IsA("GuiObject") and parent.ZIndex + 1 or 1
	img.Parent = parent
	return img
end

function M.Hex(holder, rects)
	local img=M.Icon(holder,M.Assets.hex,UDim2.fromScale(0,0),UDim2.fromScale(1,1),"SnowHex")
	img.ZIndex=holder.ZIndex img.ScaleType=Enum.ScaleType.Stretch
	img.ImageRectOffset=Vector2.new(124,50) img.ImageRectSize=Vector2.new(1006,1154)
	img.Visible=false
	local function sync()
		img.ImageColor3=rects[1].BackgroundColor3:Lerp(Color3.new(1,1,1),0.12)
		img.ImageTransparency=rects[1].BackgroundTransparency
	end
	sync()
	rects[1]:GetPropertyChangedSignal("BackgroundColor3"):Connect(sync)
	rects[1]:GetPropertyChangedSignal("BackgroundTransparency"):Connect(sync)
	whenReady(M.Assets.hex,function()
		if holder.Parent then
			img.Visible=true for _,r in ipairs(rects) do r.Visible=false end
		end
	end)
	return img
end

local accepted = {RNGGui=true, Tutorial=true, SnowArrivalGui=true, DiceBannerGui=true, TreasureToastGui=true, World2Toast=true, StageToast=true, FrostfallToast=true}
local seen = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
local function rootOf(o)
	local root = o:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("ScreenGui")
	if root and accepted[root.Name] then return root end
	local bb = o:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("BillboardGui")
	if bb and (bb.Name:sub(1,8)=="PetSign_" or bb.Name=="SnowPrompt") then return bb end
	local surface = o:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("SurfaceGui")
	local zones = workspace:FindFirstChild("SnowFieldZones")
	if surface and not (zones and surface:IsDescendantOf(zones)) then return surface end
end
local function apply(o)
	if not o or not o.Parent or o:GetAttribute("SnowUIDecor") or seen[o] or not o:IsA("GuiObject") then return end
	local root = rootOf(o)
	if not root then return end
	if o:IsA("ScrollingFrame") then
		o.ScrollBarImageColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(124,224,255)
		o.ScrollBarThickness = math.min(o.ScrollBarThickness,7)
		seen[o] = true return
	end
	if o:IsA("ImageLabel") and o.Name=="Background" and o.Parent.Parent and o.Parent.Parent.Name=="Panels" then
		seen[o] = true
		whenReady(M.Assets.panel,function()
			if o.Parent then o.Image=M.Assets.panel o.ScaleType=Enum.ScaleType.Slice o.SliceCenter=M.Slice o.SliceScale=0.2 end
		end)
		return
	end
	if o.Name=="Shadow" or o.Name=="Glow" or o.Name=="Aura" or o.Name=="Fill" or o.Name=="Shine" then return end
	if root:IsA("SurfaceGui") and o.Parent==root and o.BackgroundTransparency<0.9 then
		if not o:FindFirstChildOfClass("UICorner") then
			local c=Instance.new("UICorner") c.CornerRadius=UDim.new(0.1,0) c.Parent=o
		end
		seen[o]=true M.Skin(o,"card") return
	end
	if o:IsA("Frame") or o:IsA("TextButton") or o:IsA("TextBox") then
		if o.BackgroundTransparency>=0.9 or not o:FindFirstChildOfClass("UICorner") then return end
		-- A sibling border follows the automatic-size box without influencing its measurement.
		if o.AutomaticSize~=Enum.AutomaticSize.None then
			if root.Name=="Tutorial" then
				o.BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(18,73,122)
				seen[o]=true
				local border=M.Icon(o.Parent,M.Assets.card,UDim2.fromScale(0,0),UDim2.fromOffset(0,0),"SnowTutorialBorder")
				border.ZIndex=o.ZIndex+1 border.ScaleType=Enum.ScaleType.Slice border.SliceCenter=M.Slice border.SliceScale=0.055
				local function follow()
					if not o.Parent then border:Destroy() return end
					local p=o.AbsolutePosition-o.Parent.AbsolutePosition
					border.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(p.X-3,p.Y-3) border.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(o.AbsoluteSize.X+6,o.AbsoluteSize.Y+6)
					border.Visible=o.Visible
				end
				o:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(follow)
				o:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsolutePosition"):Connect(follow)
				o:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(follow)
				follow()
			end
			return
		end
		local content=o:IsA("TextButton") or o:IsA("TextBox")
		for _,c in ipairs(o:GetChildren()) do
			if c:IsA("TextLabel") or c:IsA("ViewportFrame") or c:IsA("ImageLabel") or c:IsA("TextButton") then content=true break end
		end
		if not content then return end
		seen[o]=true
		M.Skin(o,o:IsA("TextButton") and "button" or "card")
	end
end
function M.Attach(container)
	for _,o in ipairs(container:GetDescendants()) do apply(o) end
	return container.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(o)
		task.defer(function()
			if o:IsA("UICorner") or o:IsA("TextLabel") or o:IsA("ViewportFrame") then apply(o.Parent) end
			apply(o)
		end)
	end)
end
function M.StyleTree(container)
	for _,o in ipairs(container:GetDescendants()) do apply(o) end
end
function M.SnowBackground(parent)
	local img=M.Icon(parent,M.Assets.loading,UDim2.fromScale(0,0),UDim2.fromScale(1,1),"SnowBackdrop")
	img.ZIndex=0 img.ScaleType=Enum.ScaleType.Crop
	img.ImageColor3=Color3.fromRGB(100,140,185) img.ImageTransparency=0.52
	return img
end
return M

-- Client-only snowy skin and branded prompts. Existing services own all actions.
local Players=game:GetService("Players")
local RS=game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local PromptService=game:GetService("ProximityPromptService")
local TweenService=game:GetService("TweenService")
local UIS=game:GetService("UserInputService")
local UI=require(RS:WaitForChild("SnowUI"))
local pg=Players.LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
UI.Attach(pg)
UI.Attach(workspace)
local function make(class,props,parent)
	local o=Instance.new(class) for k,v in pairs(props) do o[k]=v end o.Parent=parent return o
end
local function label(parent,text,pos,size,color)
	local t=make("TextLabel",{BackgroundTransparency=1,Font=Enum.Font.FredokaOne,Text=text,TextScaled=true,
		TextColor3=color or Color3.new(1,1,1),Position=pos,Size=size,ZIndex=3},parent)
	make("UIStroke",{Color=Color3.fromRGB(17,49,83),Thickness=1.5},t) return t
end
local views={}
local function customPrompt(o)
	if o:IsA("ProximityPrompt") and (o.Style==Enum.ProximityPromptStyle.Default or o:GetAttribute("SnowUIOwnPrompt")) then
		o:SetAttribute("SnowUIOwnPrompt",true) o.Style=Enum.ProximityPromptStyle.Custom
	end
end
PromptService.PromptShown:Connect(function(prompt,inputType)
	if not prompt:GetAttribute("SnowUIOwnPrompt") or views[prompt] then return end
	local parent=prompt.Parent
	local part=parent and (parent:IsA("BasePart") and parent or parent:IsA("Attachment") and parent.Parent
		or parent:IsA("Model") and (parent.PrimaryPart or parent:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart",true)))
	if not part then return end
	local gui=make("BillboardGui",{Name="SnowPrompt",Adornee=part,AlwaysOnTop=true,LightInfluence=0,Active=true,
		Size=UDim2.fromOffset(248,80),StudsOffsetWorldSpace=Vector3.new(0,2.2,0),MaxDistance=prompt.MaxActivationDistance+4},pg)
	local body=make("Frame",{Name="Body",BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(20,84,146),BackgroundTransparency=0.08,
		Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1),BorderSizePixel=0,ZIndex=1},gui)
	make("UICorner",{CornerRadius=UDim.new(0,14)},body) UI.Skin(body,"card")
	local key=make("Frame",{BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(220,249,255),Position=UDim2.fromScale(0.055,0.22),
		Size=UDim2.fromScale(0.17,0.53),BorderSizePixel=0,ZIndex=2},body)
	make("UICorner",{CornerRadius=UDim.new(0,8)},key)
	local word=inputType==Enum.ProximityPromptInputType.Touch and "TAP"
		or inputType==Enum.ProximityPromptInputType.Gamepad and prompt.GamepadKeyCode.Name or prompt.KeyboardKeyCode.Name
	label(key,word,UDim2.fromScale(0.06,0.1),UDim2.fromScale(0.88,0.8),Color3.fromRGB(21,60,99))
	local title=label(body,prompt.ActionText,UDim2.fromScale(0.27,0.12),UDim2.fromScale(0.68,0.42))
	local sub=label(body,prompt.ObjectText,UDim2.fromScale(0.27,0.55),UDim2.fromScale(0.68,0.26),Color3.fromRGB(173,233,255))
	local track=make("Frame",{BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(10,42,85),BorderSizePixel=0,Position=UDim2.fromScale(0.27,0.87),
		Size=UDim2.fromScale(0.66,0.055),ZIndex=3,Visible=prompt.HoldDuration>0},body)
	local fill=make("Frame",{Name="Fill",Size=UDim2.fromScale(0,1),BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(120,245,255),BorderSizePixel=0,ZIndex=4},track)
	local hit=make("TextButton",{Name="Hit",Text="",BackgroundTransparency=1,Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1),Active=true,Selectable=false,ZIndex=8},body)
	local connections,held,activeInput,tween={},false,nil,nil
	local function release(input)
		if held and (not input or input==activeInput) then
			held=false activeInput=nil if prompt.Parent then prompt:InputHoldEnd() end
		end
	end
	table.insert(connections,hit.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.Touch or input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
			if not held then held,activeInput=true,input prompt:InputHoldBegin() end
		end
	end))
	table.insert(connections,UIS.InputEnded:Connect(release))
	table.insert(connections,prompt:GetPropertyChangedSignal("ActionText"):Connect(function() title.Text=prompt.ActionText end))
	table.insert(connections,prompt:GetPropertyChangedSignal("ObjectText"):Connect(function() sub.Text=prompt.ObjectText end))
	table.insert(connections,prompt.PromptButtonHoldBegan:Connect(function()
		if tween then tween:Cancel() end fill.Size=UDim2.fromScale(0,1)
		tween=TweenService:Create(fill,TweenInfo.new(prompt.HoldDuration,Enum.EasingStyle.Linear),{Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1)}) tween:Play()
	end))
	table.insert(connections,prompt.PromptButtonHoldEnded:Connect(function()
		if tween then tween:Cancel() end fill.Size=UDim2.fromScale(0,1)
	end))
	views[prompt]=function()
		release() if tween then tween:Cancel() end for _,c in ipairs(connections) do c:Disconnect() end gui:Destroy()
	end
end)
PromptService.PromptHidden:Connect(function(prompt)
	local cleanup=views[prompt] if cleanup then views[prompt]=nil cleanup() end
end)
for _,o in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do customPrompt(o) end
workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(customPrompt)

-- PetClient: PETS tab in the inventory + egg hatch animation.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

local PetConfig = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("PetConfig"))
local PetModels = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("PetModels"))
local EggModels = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("EggModels"))
local NumberFormat = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("NumberFormat"))
local SnowUI = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("SnowUI"))
local hatchedEvent = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("PetHatched")
local equipRemote = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("EquipPet")
local getPets = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("GetPets")

local gui = script.Parent
local panel = gui:WaitForChild("Panels"):WaitForChild("Inventory")
local inner = panel:WaitForChild("Inner")
local shovelContent = inner:WaitForChild("Content")
local petContent = inner:WaitForChild("PetContent")
local tabBar = inner:WaitForChild("TabBar")
local title = panel:WaitForChild("Banner"):WaitForChild("Title")

local FONT = Enum.Font.FredokaOne
local OUTLINE = Color3.fromRGB(25, 45, 90)
local WHITE = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
local MAX = PetConfig.MaxEquipped

local pets, equipped, discovered = {}, {}, {}
local updateSigns = function() end
local tab = "Shovels"
local refresh

local function tween(o, t, props, style, dir)
	local tw = TweenService:Create(o, TweenInfo.new(t, style or Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, dir or Enum.EasingDirection.Out), props)
	tw:Play()
	return tw
end
local function mk(class, props, parent)
	local o = Instance.new(class)
	for k, v in pairs(props) do o[k] = v end
	o.Parent = parent
	return o
end
local function round(p, s) mk("UICorner", {CornerRadius = UDim.new(s, 0)}, p) end
local function label(parent, t, props, st)
	local l = mk("TextLabel", {Font = FONT, TextScaled = true, TextColor3 = WHITE, BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = t}, nil)
	for k, v in pairs(props) do l[k] = v end
	if st ~= false then mk("UIStroke", {Thickness = st or 2.5, Color = OUTLINE}, l) end
	l.Parent = parent
	return l
end

-- 3D pet preview inside a frame
local function viewport(parent, petName, props)
	local vp = mk("ViewportFrame", {BackgroundTransparency = 1, Ambient = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 210),
		LightColor = WHITE, LightDirection = Vector3.new(-0.4, -1, -0.6)}, nil)
	for k, v in pairs(props) do vp[k] = v end
	local m = PetModels.create(petName)
	m:PivotTo(CFrame.new())
	m.Parent = vp
	local _, size = m:GetBoundingBox()
	local dist = math.max(size.X, size.Y) * 1.7 + 1.5
	local cam = Instance.new("Camera")
	cam.FieldOfView = 40
	cam.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.new(dist * 0.45, dist * 0.25, -dist), Vector3.new(0, 0, 0))
	cam.Parent = vp
	vp.CurrentCamera = cam
	vp.Parent = parent
	return vp, m
end

--------------------------------------------------
-- TABS
--------------------------------------------------
local function setTab(t)
	tab = t
	panel:SetAttribute("Tab", t)
	shovelContent.Visible = t == "Shovels"
	petContent.Visible = t == "Pets"
	for _, b in ipairs(tabBar:GetChildren()) do
		if b:IsA("TextButton") then
			b.BackgroundColor3 = (b.Name == t .. "Tab") and Color3.fromRGB(60, 150, 255) or Color3.fromRGB(150, 165, 190)
		end
	end
	if t == "Pets" then refresh() else
		-- let RNGClient's title come back
		local n = 0
		for _ in (Players.LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("EquippedShovels") or ""):gmatch("[^,]+") do n += 1 end
		title.Text = ("INVENTORY %d/%d"):format(n, Players.LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("ShovelSlots") or 2)
	end
end
tabBar:WaitForChild("ShovelsTab").Activated:Connect(function() setTab("Shovels") end)
tabBar:WaitForChild("PetsTab").Activated:Connect(function() setTab("Pets") end)
gui:WaitForChild("VillageOpenMenu").Event:Connect(function(name)
 if name == "Pets" then setTab("Pets") end
end)

--------------------------------------------------
-- PET CARDS
--------------------------------------------------
local function copies(name)
	local n = 0
	for _, e in ipairs(equipped) do if e == name then n += 1 end end
	return n
end

local busy = false
local function send(action, name)
	if busy then return end
	busy = true
	local ok, res = pcall(function() return equipRemote:InvokeServer(action, name) end)
	busy = false
	if ok and type(res) == "table" then equipped = res; refresh() end
end

local function smallButton(parent, props, color, text)
	local b = mk("TextButton", {Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false, BackgroundColor3 = color}, parent)
	for k, v in pairs(props) do b[k] = v end
	round(b, 1)
	mk("UIStroke", {Thickness = 3, Color = OUTLINE, ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border}, b)
	label(b, text, {Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.08, 0.14), Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.84, 0.72)}, 2)
	return b
end

local function card(order, pet, count)
	local color = PetConfig.Rarities[pet.Rarity] or WHITE
	local holder = mk("Frame", {BackgroundTransparency = 1, LayoutOrder = order}, nil)
	local shadow = mk("Frame", {BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0), BackgroundTransparency = 0.78, Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 6), Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)}, holder)
	round(shadow, 0.16)
	local main = mk("Frame", {BackgroundColor3 = WHITE, Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)}, holder)
	round(main, 0.16)
	mk("UIGradient", {Color = ColorSequence.new(color:Lerp(WHITE, 0.55), color), Rotation = 90}, main)
	local stroke = mk("UIStroke", {Thickness = 4, Color = color:Lerp(Color3.new(0, 0, 0), 0.45), ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border}, main)
	viewport(main, pet.Name, {Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.05, 0.02), Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.9, 0.44)})
	label(main, pet.Name, {Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.05, 0.46), Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.9, 0.14)}, 2.5)
	label(main, "+" .. math.floor(pet.Boost * 100 + 0.5) .. "% ❄", {Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.15, 0.6), Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.7, 0.11),
		TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 255, 150)}, 2.5)

	local on = copies(pet.Name)
	local canAdd = on < count
	local eb = smallButton(main, {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.75), Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.86, 0.17)},
		canAdd and Color3.fromRGB(60, 150, 255) or Color3.fromRGB(70, 200, 90), canAdd and "EQUIP" or "EQUIPPED")
	eb.Activated:Connect(function() if canAdd then send("equip", pet.Name) end end)
	if on > 0 then
		stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(60, 230, 90)
		stroke.Thickness = 6
		local x = smallButton(holder, {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.12, 0.07), Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.26, 0.26)},
			Color3.fromRGB(235, 70, 80), "X")
		mk("UIAspectRatioConstraint", {AspectRatio = 1}, x)
		x.Activated:Connect(function() send("unequip", pet.Name) end)
	end
	local badge = mk("Frame", {BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 215, 60), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
		Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.86, 0.07), Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.38, 0.17)}, holder)
	round(badge, 1)
	mk("UIStroke", {Thickness = 3, Color = OUTLINE, ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border}, badge)
	label(badge, "x" .. count, {Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.12, 0.12), Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.76, 0.76), TextColor3 = OUTLINE}, false)
	holder.Parent = petContent
end

refresh = function()
	for _, c in ipairs(petContent:GetChildren()) do
		if c:IsA("GuiObject") then c:Destroy() end
	end
	local order, any = 0, false
	for _, egg in ipairs(PetConfig.Eggs) do
		for _, pet in ipairs(egg.Pets) do
			order += 1
			local n = pets[pet.Name] or 0
			if n > 0 then any = true; card(order, pet, n) end
		end
	end
	if not any then
		label(petContent, "Open an egg to get your first pet! 🥚", {Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 50)}, 3)
	end
	if tab == "Pets" then
		title.Text = ("PETS %d/%d"):format(#equipped, Players.LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("PetSlots") or MAX)
	end
end

--------------------------------------------------
-- HATCH ANIMATION
--------------------------------------------------

-- New 2026 egg art: clone the Shell mesh from the lobby EggDisplay; old procedural eggs are the fallback.
local function eggArt(eggId)
	local display = workspace:FindFirstChild("EggDisplay", true)
	local src = display and display:FindFirstChild(eggId)
	if not (src and src:FindFirstChild("Shell")) then
		-- World 2 eggs (2026-10-02, Claude) stand in their own stages, not in the lobby EggDisplay
		for _, d in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
			if d:IsA("Model") and d.Name == eggId and d:FindFirstChild("Shell") then src = d; break end
		end
	end
	local shell = src and src:FindFirstChild("Shell")
	if shell and shell:IsA("MeshPart") then
		local m = Instance.new("Model")
		m.Name = eggId
		local c = shell:Clone()
		c.Anchored = true
		c.PivotOffset = CFrame.new() -- imported meshes carry a 90-degree pivot; keep the egg upright
		c.CFrame = CFrame.new()
		c.Parent = m
		m.PrimaryPart = c
		-- World 2 eggs: decoration parts tagged EggArt (petals, bands...) follow the shell
		for _, d in ipairs(src:GetChildren()) do
			if d:IsA("BasePart") and d:GetAttribute("EggArt") then
				local e = d:Clone()
				e.Anchored = true
				e.CFrame = shell.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(d.CFrame)
				e.Parent = m
			end
		end
		return m
	end
	return EggModels.create(eggId)
end

local playing = false
local function playHatch(eggId, petName, isNew)
	playing = true
	for _, c in ipairs(stage:GetChildren()) do if c:IsA("ViewportFrame") then c:Destroy() end end
	topText.Text, nameText.Text, subText.Text = "", "", ""
	overlay.Visible = true
	overlay.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	tween(overlay, 0.25, {BackgroundTransparency = 0.45})
	tween(blur, 0.25, {Size = 18})

	-- the egg: a clone of the real egg model if possible
	local eggVp = mk("ViewportFrame", {BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), ZIndex = 21,
		Ambient = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 210), LightColor = WHITE, LightDirection = Vector3.new(-0.4, -1, -0.6)}, stage)
	local eggModel = eggArt(eggId)
	eggModel:PivotTo(CFrame.new())
	eggModel.Parent = eggVp
	local _, size = eggModel:GetBoundingBox()
	local cam = Instance.new("Camera")
	cam.FieldOfView = 40
	cam.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.new(0, size.Y * 0.15, -math.max(size.X, size.Y) * 2.2), Vector3.new(0, 0, 0))
	cam.Parent = eggVp
	eggVp.CurrentCamera = cam
	topText.Text = "Hatching..."

	-- shake harder and harder
	local t0 = os.clock()
	while os.clock() - t0 < 1.6 do
		local k = (os.clock() - t0) / 1.6
		eggModel:PivotTo(CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.sin(os.clock() * (18 + k * 30)) * (0.08 + k * 0.28)))
		task.wait()
	end

	-- pop!
	flash.BackgroundTransparency = 0
	tween(flash, 0.5, {BackgroundTransparency = 1})
	eggVp:Destroy()
	local pet = PetConfig.PetByName[petName]
	local color = pet and PetConfig.Rarities[pet.Rarity] or WHITE
	local vp, model = viewport(stage, petName, {Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), ZIndex = 21})
	local popScale = mk("UIScale", {Scale = 0.3}, stage)
	tween(popScale, 0.45, {Scale = 1}, Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
	topText.Text = isNew and "NEW PET!" or "You hatched"
	topText.TextColor3 = isNew and Color3.fromRGB(255, 230, 90) or WHITE
	nameText.Text = petName
	nameText.TextColor3 = color
	subText.Text = (pet and pet.Rarity or "") .. "  •  +" .. math.floor((pet and pet.Boost or 0) * 100 + 0.5) .. "% ❄"
	subText.TextColor3 = WHITE

	local t1 = os.clock()
	while os.clock() - t1 < 2.4 do
		model:PivotTo(CFrame.Angles(0, (os.clock() - t1) * 1.5, 0))
		task.wait()
	end
	tween(overlay, 0.3, {BackgroundTransparency = 1})
	tween(blur, 0.3, {Size = 0})
	task.wait(0.3)
	popScale:Destroy()
	vp:Destroy()
	overlay.Visible = false
	topText.Text, nameText.Text, subText.Text = "", "", ""
	playing = false
end

local SHOW_DISTANCE = 25
local HIDE_DISTANCE = 30
task.spawn(function()
	while true do
		local char = Players.LocalPlayer.Character
		local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		-- eggs stand close together in the lobby row: only the nearest egg's sign may show
		local nearest, nearestDist = nil, math.huge
		for _, entry in pairs(signs) do
			if entry.bb and entry.part and entry.part.Parent and hrp then
				local d = (hrp.Position - entry.part.Position).Magnitude
				if d < nearestDist then nearest, nearestDist = entry, d end
			end
		end
		for _, entry in pairs(signs) do
			if entry.bb and entry.part and entry.part.Parent then
				local dist = hrp and (hrp.Position - entry.part.Position).Magnitude or math.huge
				if entry ~= nearest then dist = math.huge end
				if not entry.shown and dist < SHOW_DISTANCE then
					entry.shown = true
					entry.bb.Enabled = true
					entry.scale.Scale = 0
					tween(entry.scale, 0.35, {Scale = 1}, Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
				elseif entry.shown and dist > HIDE_DISTANCE then
					entry.shown = false
					local tw = tween(entry.scale, 0.2, {Scale = 0}, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In)
					tw.Completed:Connect(function()
						if not entry.shown then entry.bb.Enabled = false end
					end)
				end
			end
		end
		task.wait(0.15)
	end
end)

local function mk(class, props, parent)
	local o = Instance.new(class)
	for k, v in pairs(props) do o[k] = v end
	if parent then o.Parent = parent end
	return o
end
local function round(o, r) return mk("UICorner", {CornerRadius = UDim.new(r or 0.2, 0)}, o) end
local function outline(o, th, color, mode)
	return mk("UIStroke", {Thickness = th or 2, Color = color or DARK, ApplyStrokeMode = mode or Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border}, o)

local function text(parent, str, props, max, dark)
	local l = mk("TextLabel", {BackgroundTransparency = 1, Font = FONT, Text = str, TextColor3 = dark and TEXT_DARK or WHITE,
		TextScaled = true, TextWrapped = true, Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)}, parent)

	if not dark then outline(l, 2, DARK, Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Contextual) end
	mk("UITextSizeConstraint", {MaxTextSize = max or 32}, l)

local function tween(o, t, goal, style, dir)
	local tw = TweenService:Create(o, TweenInfo.new(t, style or Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, dir or Enum.EasingDirection.Out), goal)
	tw:Play()
	return tw
end
local function clock(s)
	s = math.max(0, math.floor(s))
	local h, m = math.floor(s / 3600), math.floor(s % 3600 / 60)
	if h > 0 then return string.format("%dh %02dm", h, m) end
	return string.format("%d:%02d", m, s % 60)
end
